# vengtoo_subject

A subject is an actor in your system — a user, service, or device that performs actions on resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vengtoo_subject" "alice" {
  name = "Alice"
  type = "user"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Subject name.
- `type` (String) Subject type: one of user, service, device, custom, ai_agent.

### Optional

- `external_id` (String) Your system's reference ID for this subject. Usable in /v1/authorize as an alternative to the subject's UUID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Subject ID.

## Import

Subjects can be imported using their ID:

```shell
terraform import vengtoo_subject.alice <subject-id>
```
